_doc: Words the course adds to the N5-N4 lists (OpenJLPT / Waller) because learners need them from the first lessons and the lists lack them (2026-11-15: 私 is listed only as わたくし, 何 only as なん; そして only as そうして, そう only as the auxiliary; set phrases ありがとうございます, おはようございます, 何曜日 and 方 ほう for comparisons are missing; 2026-11-16: 時 とき for 〜とき and しまう for 〜てしまう, both N4 grammar points; おる, the humble いる of N4 keigo). They are marked extra in data/jlpt/vocabulary.json. DRAFT: to be reviewed by a Japanese teacher.
